description: Flipt is an open-source feature flag platform: manage flags, segments and rollouts from a web UI or API, with flag state stored as YAML in a Git-backed store — no external database required.
name: Flipt
seoDescription: Deploy Flipt with Docker Compose on Dokploy — the open-source feature flag server with a web UI, REST and gRPC APIs, and Git-backed flag storage in one container.
